note: First version: the 1 dp line in the card border colour that layouts drew under rows as a Box over an empty Spacer

component.doc: A 1 dp line across its parent, in the card border colour unless color says otherwise: between the rows of a list you draw yourself, under a heading, or between the sections of a card. It is softer than core://Divider, which draws in the theme's outline colour. For a list item with a divider under it use @core/divided_item.

params.name: color
params.doc: Its colour (#RRGGBB or a binding such as ${local://theme#card_border}).

examples.note: under each row of a to-do list, in a Column with the row
an accent rule under a section's heading
